resolution: Added a native OS file picker to the model viewer (the drop flow felt unreliable). Reused the exact mechanism the Studio import already had: promoted a shared runtime/hooks/pickFile (zenity --file-selection via execAsync, with shell-quote escaping) and refactored the Studio's cart/hmsc-int pickModelFile to delegate to it — one identical picker behind both, satisfying rule-of-two. cart/modelview.tsx now leads with a 'Choose a model…' button plus a title-bar 'Open…' to swap models; drag-drop stays as a bonus path, and all sources share one applyPath loader. Dropped .gltf from the accepted extensions because the host parser reads the self-contained binary .glb, not JSON-plus-external-bin .gltf. zenity is present on this box; self-shot verified the empty prompt (button) and a loaded model (car.obj, 180 tris, Open button). The picker dialog itself is interactive so it can't be headless-shot, but it is the same proven Studio call.
